name: Bookmarks
description: A place to put links so you can find them again. Paste a URL anywhere in the frame and it saves itself — no form, no dialog — reading a name off the address and colouring the site so the same site always looks the same. The search box is the frame's real interface: it filters by title, address and tag as you type. Tag anything, filter by tag, rename what the URL got wrong. Editors save and edit; viewers and anonymous visitors can read and follow the same links. Nothing is fetched from the sites you save: the frame asks for no network access at all, so a private bookmark stays private. Links are the space's table bookmarks.table.jsonl, so they sync with the space and open in any table tool.
